notes: Original SvR 2011 clips per wrestler and SSB64 presentation role. Policy and heuristics: evidence/ANIMATION_SETS.md. Roles missing here fall back to the SSB64 motion (labelled).

idle.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (data (superstar slot 0 = 1700 for all 12 wrestlers, chEtc.pac CHAR/PRO) + visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_basic.png row 0))

walk.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (data (superstar slot 1 = 9900; planted-foot drift = forward) + visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_basic.png row 2; evidence/svr_motion/validate_STAT_9900_0_walk_john_cena.png))

run.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (data (superstar slot 2 = 6801, WAZE name 'Normal') + visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_basic.png row 6))

run_start.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (same clip as run (SSB64 dash start))

run_brake.move: run that decelerates to a halt (ends bent forward)
run_brake.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_h_locomotion.png row 1) + data (root travels 16.9 dm forward then stops))

block.move: blocked punch idle: holds the opponent's punching arm (loop)
block.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_j_holds_turns.png row 7) + data (in-game controls list: BLOCKING PUNCHES (RT) -> BLOCKED PUNCH IDLE, string.pac strings 30385-30398; decoder loop flag). SvR has no free-standing guard; matching this clip to that state is inferred from the pose)

hit_hi.move: head snaps back, leans far back, recovers
hit_hi.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_e_reactions.png rows 14, 3; strength order judged from the size of the reaction))

hit_n.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_e_reactions.png rows 4, 3, 0) + data (backward root travel 1.8 / 0 / 4.8 dm); strength order judged from the size of the reaction)

hit_lw.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_e_reactions.png rows 0, 15) + data (backward root travel 4.8 / 2.9 dm; pain-voice cue 3003); strength order judged from the size of the reaction)

knockdown.move: knocked down: staggers backwards onto the back / falls forward onto the face
knockdown.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_d_knockdowns.png rows 9, 10) + data (end pose face up / face down from toe-vs-heel height; backward / forward root travel 18 / 11.6 dm))

downed.move: lying on the back / face down (loops)
downed.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_basic.png rows 9, 10) + data (root height -1.8 / -1.4 dm, toe-vs-heel orientation, decoder loop flag))

getup.move: get up from the back / from face down
getup.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_basic.png row 11, stat_a.png row 1) + data (start lying face up / face down, end standing))

getup_roll.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_a.png rows 4, 5) + data (start lying, end standing, root travel 14.6 / 14.9 dm). Roll direction relative to SSB64 forward/back not determined)

grab.move: chain-grapple entry: grabs the opponent into a front facelock
grab.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_b.png row 11) + data (superstar slot 59 default = 100; slots 57-60 = 103/102/100/101 follow the editor's chain-grapple blocks waist lock / side headlock / front facelock / wrist lock); the slot link is inferred)

grab_hold.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_j_holds_turns.png row 0) + data (decoder loop flag on both roles; variant 50 of the front-facelock entry 100))

captured.source: SvR 2011 generic motion (visual (render evidence/svr_moves/sheets/stat_j_holds_turns.png row 0, stat_b.png row 11) + data (role 1 of the same clips; loop flag))
